senses.gloss:
अह्नाय ind. Soon, instantly.
 E. अ neg. ह्नाय from ह्नु to take away or
secrete, with घञ् affix, and य substituted for the व to which the
radical त is changed.

आह्न n. (-ह्नं) Many days.
 E. अहन् a day, and अण् aff.

आह्निक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Daily, diurnal, of or belonging to a day.
 n.
(-कं)
 1. Constant occupation, daily work.
 2. The division or section
of a book.
 3. Food.
 E. अहन् a day, and ठक् aff.

आह्निकाचार m. (-रः) Daily observance, the prayers and practices neces-
sary for bodily and mental purification.
 E. आह्निक daily and आचार
observance.
